Get Playlist By Handle and Slug

GET 
/playlists/by_permalink/:handle/:slug

Get a playlist by handle and slug

Request​

Path Parameters

    handle stringrequired

    playlist owner handle

    slug stringrequired

    playlist slug

Query Parameters

    user_id string

    The user ID of the user making the request

Responses​

  • 200

Success

  • application/json
